<thought>Since searching with functional group criteria returned no templates, we will retrieve all templates that can be applied to the target molecule by searching the catalog without specifying functional groups. This will give us candidate templates, from which we can identify the one that performs the ester‑to‑aldehyde reduction (the DIBAL‑H transformation).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "limit": 20
}
</action_input>
